note: The launch video's voice-over, line by line. `bar` is where the line starts on the music grid (144 BPM, 4/4, one bar = 1.6667 s, bar 1 = the first bar of music). Record each line as vo/<id>.wav (mono or stereo, any sample rate) and re-render: the edit picks the files up by id. The placeholder files are the Mac's built-in voice (vo/make.sh).

lines.text: This is Crownfall. A fantasy battler you can play today.
Draft an army. Place it. Watch it fight.
Rather it wasn't fantasy? Tell Claude.
Same battle. Same rules. A completely different game.
We run the game underneath: the rules, the servers, the ladder.
You redesign everything a player sees and hears.
And every level is a real place. Streets, cover, ambushes. Spin it like a globe.
